meta.mechanism: extended-duration small interfering RNA targeting hepatic LPA (apolipoprotein(a)) mRNA
meta.indication: reduction of MACE in adults with Lp(a) >= 175 nmol/L with established ASCVD or at risk of a first CV event (high-risk primary prevention)

expected_readout.location: Registry statusModule: primaryCompletionDate 2029-03 (ESTIMATED), last update posted 2026-09-24
expected_readout.note: Registry field, not a quotable sentence. BioSpace (S4, 2026-09-08): 'initial data expected in 2029' (secondary). Event-driven; no Lilly statement on timing after the pelacarsen failure found.

n_randomized.note: Registry field, ESTIMATED although status is ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING (actual count not yet posted). Registry summary adds: 'Approximately 1700 additional participants will be enrolled in an addendum to explore Lp(a) lowering with an alternative dosing schema.' Conflicting figures elsewhere: 16,700 (J Clin Med 2026 review table, S6) and ~12,500 (unattributed search snippet).

median_followup.quote: Baseline up to End of Study (About 4.5 Years)

primary_endpoint.value: time to first MACE-4: CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal ischemic stroke, urgent coronary revascularization
primary_endpoint.quote: Time to first event in a MACE-4 composite endpoint, comprised of cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal ischemic stroke, and urgent coronary revascularization.
primary_endpoint.note: Secondary endpoints include MACE-4 separately in established-ASCVD, at-risk-for-first-event, and Lp(a) >= 200 nmol/L populations.

inclusion_key_criteria.value: Lp(a) >= 175 nmol/L AND either (2a) age >= 18 with established ASCVD with event or revascularization, or (2b) age >= 55 at risk for first CV event (documented CAD, carotid stenosis or PAD without event/revascularization; familial hypercholesterolemia; or combination of high-risk factors)
inclusion_key_criteria.note: Registry 2b: 'Individuals 55 years of age or older who are at risk for a first cardiovascular (CV) event'. Excludes major CV event or surgery < 60 days before screening.

planned_events.note: NOT FOUND: no design paper or public SAP located (Europe PMC, PubMed, Lilly releases). Lilly investor/trial sites timed out from this environment.

stopped_early.note: Ongoing; not stopped as of registry update 2026-09-24.

dose_regimen.quote: lepodisiran is administered as an easy-to-administer subcutaneous injection every six months
dose_regimen.note: Dose NOT FOUND in registry (arms: 'administered subcutaneously (SC)'). Every-six-months from patient-advocacy page (S5, secondary). An unattributed search snippet instead described 'first 3 doses 6 months apart, then every 12 months' (unverified).

baseline.note: NOT FOUND for ACCLAIM-Lp(a). Entry threshold >= 175 nmol/L (S1).

baseline.quote: A total of 320 participants underwent randomization; the median baseline lipoprotein(a) concentration was 253.9 nmol per liter.

biomarker_effects.method: placebo-adjusted time-averaged percent change from baseline in serum Lp(a); pooled 400 mg groups
biomarker_effects.quote: -93.9 percentage points (95% CI, -95.1 to -92.5) in the pooled 400-mg groups
biomarker_effects.note: Primary endpoint of ALPACA. 96 mg: -75.2 (-80.4 to -68.5); 16 mg: -40.8 (-55.8 to -20.6).

biomarker_effects.method: placebo-adjusted time-averaged percent change; 400 mg at day 0 and day 180
biomarker_effects.quote: -94.8 percentage points (95% CI, -95.9 to -93.4) in the 16-mg, 96-mg, 400-mg-placebo, and 400-mg-400-mg dose groups, respectively
biomarker_effects.note: Value for 400 mg-400 mg group (last in list). Single 400 mg dose (400 mg-placebo): -88.5 (-90.8 to -85.6).

biomarker_effects.method: placebo-adjusted time-averaged percent change; single 400 mg dose
biomarker_effects.note: 400 mg at baseline, placebo at day 180.

safety_signals.value: phase 2: dose-dependent, generally mild injection-site reactions in up to 12% (8/69) at highest dose; serious AEs (35 participants) none deemed drug-related
safety_signals.quote: Dose-dependent, generally mild injection-site reactions occurred in up to 12% (8 of 69) of the participants in the highest lepodisiran dose group.

genetics.finding: LPA variants (rs10455872, rs3798220) raise Lp(a) and coronary disease risk; association abolished after adjusting for Lp(a)
genetics.quote: Our findings provide support for a causal role of Lp(a) lipoprotein in coronary disease.

genetics.finding: MR: CHD benefit proportional to absolute Lp(a) reduction; ~101.5 mg/dL lowering equivalent to 1 mmol/L LDL-C
genetics.effect: OR 0.942 (0.933-0.951) per 10 mg/dL lower genetically predicted Lp(a)
genetics.quote: The clinical benefit of lowering Lp(a) is likely to be proportional to the absolute reduction in Lp(a) concentration.

genetics.finding: Lp(a)-GWAS-Consortium MR: 65.7 mg/dL lowering required to match 38.67 mg/dL LDL-C lowering
genetics.quote: This mendelian randomization analysis estimated a required Lp(a)-lowering effect size of 65.7 mg/dL to reach the same effect as a 38.67-mg/dL lowering of LDL-C.

consensus_explanation.summary: Not applicable: forecast case, outcome pending. Context: Lp(a)HORIZON (pelacarsen, ASO, ~80% expected lowering, secondary prevention, Lp(a) >= 70 mg/dL) missed its primary endpoint on 2026-09-04 (S10). ACCLAIM differs by deeper lowering (~94% in phase 2), a lower nmol/L entry threshold than OCEAN(a) (>= 175 vs >= 200 nmol/L) and inclusion of high-risk primary prevention. No Lilly statement on the pelacarsen failure was found.

pre_readout.note: Forecast case: no readout yet. Lists key facts public as of 2026-10-05.
available_before_readout: Registry design: populations, Lp(a) >= 175 nmol/L, MACE-4 endpoint, N 17,300 est., primary completion 2029-03 (S1, first posted 2024-03-04; last update 2026-09-24)
ALPACA phase 2: -93.9 pp (400 mg pooled, day 60-180), -94.8 pp (400/400, day 30-360); baseline median 253.9 nmol/L (S2, 2025-03-30)
only_after_readout: Planned events, assumed RRR, power, alpha, phase 3 dose, baseline Lp(a) of phase 3 cohort: NOT public

access_summary.note: Registry: N (estimated), primary endpoint, Lp(a) threshold, primary completion. Abstract only (NEJM 2025): -93.9, -94.8, -88.5 pp and baseline 253.9 nmol/L. Not found: planned events, assumed RRR, power, alpha, phase 3 dose, phase 3 baseline Lp(a).

open_questions: Enrollment conflict: registry 17,300 (ESTIMATED, status active-not-recruiting) vs 16,700 in J Clin Med 2026 review table (S6) vs ~12,500 in an unattributed search snippet; plus ~1,700 addendum participants on an alternative dosing schema (registry). Actual randomized N not posted.
Dosing regimen conflict: 'every six months' (S5) vs 'first 3 doses 6 months apart, then every 12 months' (unattributed search snippet). Phase 3 dose (presumably 400 mg) is not stated in the registry.
Planned events, assumed RRR, power, alpha: no design paper or SAP found.
Lilly press release (S3) 1-year and ~1.5-year figures (91.0% and 74.2%) were seen only via a summarizer of the BioSpace reprint; not used as facts.
No Lilly statement responding to the pelacarsen failure was found.
Baseline Lp(a) of the ACCLAIM cohort not public; mixed primary/secondary prevention population means event rates and Lp(a) distribution will differ from Lp(a)HORIZON and OCEAN(a)-Outcomes.
